# Full Patch Notes:

Read the full patch notes on the RetroDECK Wiki.

🔗 Link:  [RetroDECK v0.10.10b](https://retrodeck.readthedocs.io/en/latest/wiki_rd_versions/version_0.10.0b/0.10.10b/)

## About: RetroDECK GitHub Releases

RetroDECK is **NOT** considered **"released"** until it is published on Flathub. 

That is because GitHub releases can on rare occasions break in the publication process between:

`Cooker (GitHub)` -> `Cooker Final (GitHub)` ->  `Main RC (GitHub)` -> `Main Master (GitHub)` -> `Testing (Flathub)` -> `Stable (Flathub)`.

The release might need more tweaking and Flathub fixes before the publication happens.

RetroDECK releases only become officially available to everyone only after it is published on Flathub. 

⚠️ Avoid upgrading from GitHub ⚠️

- Always upgrade through Flathub using your distribution's built-in app store.


### ADDED
- PPSSPP: Exposed PSP/GAME to retrodeck/storage/PPSSPP/GAME.
- PPSSPP-Core: Exposed retroarch/saves/PPSSPP/PSP/GAME to retrodeck/storage/retroarch-core/PPSSPP/GAME.

- FRAMEWORK: Fixed Flatpak library pathing error in manifest.

- ICONS: Resolved multiple icon alignment and background issues.
- MELONDS: Reset Configuration reset due to changes in the toml structure.
- RETROARCH: Resolved compatibility issue with genesis_plus_gx_paprium_libretro core.
- RETROARCH: Resolved configuration issues with the MelonDS DS cores OpenGL renderer and the number of selectable layouts.
- VITA3K: Resolved longstanding org.kde.Platform compatibility issue blocking updates.
- 
### UPDATED
- Azahar, Dolphin, ES-DE, MAME, PCSX2, Ruffle, RPCS3, Solarus, SRM, Xemu, Vita3K, XRoar

rpcsx_clanker.releaseNotes:
# RPCSX-UI app — v2026.07.08-1138

Android frontend. This release adds playing games straight from a folder you pick
(including ISOs), a sortable/filterable library, safer game removal, and RPCN/power UX.

## Game library
- Games folder: scan a folder you choose, in place (all-files access), including
  direct ISO play; boot content:// ISOs via a SAF fd with no extraction
- Sort the library (Last played / Name) and filter it (Installed / Games folder /
  Only played) from persistent top-bar toggles
- De-duplicate the same title across install sources
- Removal reworked: a games-folder entry is never kicked off the list (move its
  file out of the folder to remove it); only installed copies can be deleted, behind
  a confirmation; Clear Cache works for any game (keyed by title id, incl. ISOs); a
  user's source ISO/folder is never deleted
- Storage-permission prompt asked once, up front; robust installed-vs-folder
  classification; onBoot hardened against an unsynced list

## Launch / frontends
- Other frontends (Daijisho, ES-DE, ...) can launch a game directly via intent

## Power / gameplay UX
- Opt-in GPU turbo toggle (max Adreno clocks, off by default), mutually exclusive
  with battery saver, plus an in-game home-menu bridge
- Keep the screen on during long precompiles and gameplay
- Fix quit-to-recents ANR; fix overlay dpad/face-button drift when scaled; show the
  install-failure dialog even when notifications are denied

## Online (RPCN)
- Live connection-status indicator (polled, non-blocking); auto-connect on
  enable/startup; clearer create-vs-sign-in and Test-connection gating

## Stability
- Crash-loop breaker for a core that hard-crashes during load (durable flag);
  ProgressRepository request-id race fix; smooth-shaders toggle in Clanker settings

Head over to our discord for more help: https://slippi.gg/discord

## Changes
### New Features ✨
- New websocket-based matchmaking service
  - Should mostly work the same but includes some security fixes
  - If you notice any new issues with matchmaking such as errors or failures that didn't exist before, please let us know in the Discord
  - Minor ranked mode player matching improvements
- Input suggestions. These are mid-frame input messages which have an effect similar to reducing ping by 16.7 ms
  - It is a re-implementation of the concept Arte (@JulienBernard3383279) discovered and proved out which he called "subframe rollback". ([Arte's explanation video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t5TZKyjvCxs))
  - Renamed it to avoid confusion with a possible future change supporting subframe delay frames
- Party mode changes. The purpose of these changes is to make the mode more useable even with low player volume
  - If two (or three) players are in queue for a bit and a 3rd/4th cannot be found, the party mode match will start with whoever is available
  - Now 4-stocks with 8-minute timer
  - Games can be left at will using LRAS. If eliminated, you may choose to watch the rest or LRAS
  - Improved disconnect handling for the players remaining
- Connection quality checks which terminate ranked matches have been changed and consider stalls now
  - Might still need tweaking. If you feel that too many matches are being terminated incorrectly, please mention it in the Discord
- Replay data changes
  - Now includes information about ranked info, ranked mmr, and bot status. Replays from all modes will show a player's ranked information this way. This **does not** show unranked ratings
  - Adds additional character specific information to post frame data update

- Fixed desyncs on Kongo Jungle and Peach's Castle
- Improved RNG seed handling when playing online
- Fixed bug where rank icon could show Unranked incorrectly
- Fixed minor menu text sizing issues in 1p modes

- Connections should now recover better following a lag spike
- Removed the "Reduce timing dispersion" option. It had likely been making things worse since the emulation speed changes
- Ported security fixes from upstream Dolphin
- Changed custom game file handling and construction

steam_rom_manager.releaseNotes:
# 2.6.3

Scripts that run before and after your games, Epic games that Steam tracks until you quit, and fixes for local artwork, Non-SRM Shortcuts icons and title variables.

## Script wrapper

Parsers have a new section, **Script Wrapper Configuration**. Turn on **Wrap shortcut in a shell script** and you can choose up to three scripts to run with each game:

- **Pre-launch:** runs before the game starts.
- **Post-launch:** runs once the game has started.
- **Post-exit:** runs after you quit the game.

Each script can have a delay in seconds (0 by default). On Windows the scripts are PowerShell scripts; on Linux and macOS they are shell scripts. They can use the environment variables `SRM_GAME_TITLE`, `SRM_STAGE` and `SRM_RUN_DIR`, a folder where a game's scripts can leave files for each other.

Things to know:

- **Steam shows the game as running until you quit it**, even if the game was started through a launcher.
- **A script can't stop your game from launching.** If a script is missing or fails, SRM writes that, with the script's output, to `launch-wrappers/launch.log` in SRM's data folder, and the game starts anyway.
- **A post-launch script should finish quickly.** SRM only starts watching for the game to exit once it has finished, so start long-running tools in the background.
- **Turning the wrapper on or off replaces the parser's shortcuts** the next time you save to Steam, because the shortcuts' app IDs change.
- **On Linux, games from parsers that force a compatibility tool (such as Proton) are not wrapped**, because the tool can't run a shell script.

See the new Script Wrapper docs in the parser editor for details.

## Epic: wait for the game to exit

The Epic parser has a new **Wait for the game to exit** option (Windows, when launching through Epic). Steam then shows the game as running until you quit it. SRM also restarts Epic before the game starts, and after you quit it waits for Epic to finish syncing your cloud saves, then closes Epic. Thanks to [@hbogaeus](https://github.com/hbogaeus) for the idea and the original script ([#904](https://github.com/SteamGridDB/steam-rom-manager/pull/904)).

## Battle.net

Battle.net games now use the same script wrapper. SRM restarts Battle.net, waits until it is ready, then launches the game, as before. Now Steam also shows the game as running until you quit it, and SRM no longer downloads a script for this from GitHub.

**Your Battle.net shortcuts will be replaced** the next time you save, because their app IDs change. SRM sets their artwork again, but Steam may not carry over things it keeps for each shortcut, such as play time.

## Fixes

- **The file picker opens in the last folder you used again**, for example when adding local artwork. This stopped working in 2.6.0.
- **Non-SRM Shortcuts icons show up in Steam.** The icon was saved, but Steam didn't use it. Also, removing artwork from a Non-SRM Shortcut no longer deletes the shortcut itself, which could happen with shortcuts you made in Steam.
- **Title variables follow the title as it changes.** `${fuzzyTitle}` used to skip the title from your custom variables when fuzzy matching failed or was off. And a variable for a step that hadn't happened (for example, no custom variable matched) was empty. Each variable now holds the title as it was after its step. If a step changed nothing, it holds the title from the step before.

## Docs

- A new diagram shows how a game's title is made, step by step. It appears in the Title Modifier, Title from Custom Variable and Fuzzy Matching docs.
- Corrected the note about `${fuzzyTitle}`.
- You can now select and copy text in the docs.

stella_pc.releaseNotes:
A new major release of Stella is now available; first time in over two years!  Here are some of the changes:

  * Enhanced ROM launcher to allow multiple images per ROM.

  * Made heaps of additional images available for the ROM launcher.

  * Added searching by filename for ROM launcher images.

  * Added option to start random ROM.

  * Added automatically enabled phosphor modes.

  * Enhanced Game Properties dialog for multigame ROMs.

  * Added 2nd UI theme and hotkey for toggling UI theme.

  * Added bezel support (incl. Sinden Lightgun).

  * Added optional type format detection based on colors used.

  * Added Joy2B+ controller support.

  * Added auto detection for QuadTari attached controllers.

  * Enhanced Kid Vid support to play tape audio.

  * Added port selection, used for controller default mapping.

  * Added missing PlusROM support for E7 bankswitching.

  * Enhanced movie cart (MVC) support.

  * Accelerated emulation up to ~15% (ARM).

  * Added limited GameLine Master Module bankswitching support.

  * Added 03E0 bankswitching for Brazilian Parker Bros ROMs.

  * Added WF8 bankswitching used by some certain Coleco white carts.

  * Added JANE bankswitching used by Coleco's Tarzan prototype.

  * Added ELF mapper for Mattress Monkeys.

  * Added BUS bankswitching support for some older demos.

  * Fixed broken 7800 pause key support.

  * Added developer option for random hotspot peek values.

  * Added user defined CPU cycle timers to debugger.

  * Removed 'launcherroms' option, since it was causing some issues.

  * Codebase now uses C++20 features, which means a minimum of gcc-11
    or clang-10 for Linux/Mac, and Visual Studio 2022 for Windows.

-Have fun!

# Version 1.4.1
A smaller update for 1.4.0, just to fix some urgent issues.

## Features
- Added support for x86_64 and ARM32 devices
- Web games can now load embedded Flash, Shockwave and Unity content with Swiff runtimes
- Added an "Allow network connections" option
- Runtimes and support packs are now hosted on Swiff's infrastructure (no more download errors!)
- Shockwave players can now be managed and deleted from Data management

## Fixes
- Improved mouse handling on Wine runtimes for games that lock or hide the cursor (Ex. first-person games)
- Flashpoint Navigator is more stable on ARM devices and waits longer for slow games to start
- Gamepads that report the D-Pad as a hat axis are now detected correctly in the layout editor
- J2ME games that are missing their application file are downloaded again when you launch them
- Fixed Shockwave player installation checks and cleanup
- The runtime update status no longer disappears when refreshing the runtime info
- Checksum errors now show the expected and received hash

Special message, thanks for all the support that you guys gave to Swiff, hopefully the next update will blow your mind!

vircon32.releaseNotes:
This is the Vircon32 emulator for computers. This version fixes a few minor or latent bugs in the emulator. Also, from this release the binaries are now built with YML GitHub workflows.

## Requirements
The Vircon32 emulator requires either OpenGL Core 3.0 or OpenGL ES 2/3.
Note that the binaries provided here were all built to use OpenGL Core.

## How to install
Choose from the files below to install the Vircon32 emulator on Windows or Linux. Depending on your operating system, the process to prepare the emulator for use will be different.

Windows:
--------
Just extract the ZIP into any folder. All needed DLL files are already included.
  
Linux:
--------
Install the DEB or RPM package (depending on your system) using the corresponding commands. 

**DEB:**
Install package:
`sudo dpkg -i <package>`

Then install the dependencies:
`sudo apt-get install -f`

**RPM:**
Use yum to install the package allong with its dependencies:
`sudo yum localinstall <package>`

Mac:
-------
Extract the compressed file into any folder with write permission.
Then use Hombrew to install the dependencies:
`brew install SDL2`
`brew install libpng`

winlator_cmod.releaseNotes:
Hello!

It's been a little while, so I thought I would just give a small update on project status. 

- Winlator Cmod development continues!
- My focus on next release will either be mostly QoL. This means addressing long standing bug fixes, but more importantly, **merging and crediting improvements from other forks of Cmod from trusted developers.** Primarily I'll be focused on:
- Fixing dynamic package name paths for the gamepad implementation so that name can be changed, such as adding a ludashi benchmark version with the SDL joystick native controller support.
- Input control / touch screen control bindings bug fixes
- Minor UI improvements and enhancements
- Updating all drivers, Fex, Box64, and graphics Wrapper, following Pipetto-Crypto's advice when it comes to Streamlining and avoiding feature creep (...and avoiding pure AI code slop). 
- Improve ALSA-Reflector so audio stops cutting out after 15 minutes unless you switch to headphones.

I'm leaning on this being v13.2. A v14 Cmod should be more substantial. Ultimately I would like to overhaul how Containers are created, with a focus on something more aligned and user friendly like Gamehub, such as starting the app and choosing a Windows based executable directly in the UI, then auto creating or maintain a single container or edge case containers. This would work well with something like Per Game Fixes, or a standardized compatibility list like what's on Reddit.  

Lastly, I'm sorry I'm not good about addressing Github issues. I just have not had any time. However, it is all incredibly helpful for me; the time that I do have to spend on the next release and addressing what issues have been posted this past year (...and _cough_ Arc _cough_ raiding...). I am also looking forward to what Valve brings to the table with the Frame and it's ARM based Linux OS with Android app support. I imagine Proton is going to be getting some major improvements for ARM over the next year, so I don't see things slowing down much. Google seems to be walking back some of the unknown app restrictions they announced this year, so that's also good. Lots to look forward to. 

Stay Kazzy,
Goro Majima
_Majima Construction_

**Little update here... 03/06/2026** 
I pretty much finished my Joy-Con 2 / Nintendo Switch 2 Pro controller bluetooth driver/CLI tool for Linux systems, so I can get back to Winlator/PC Emulation on Android in general. 

You can check that out here: https://github.com/coffincolors/jc2mouse/releases/tag/v0.3.0-beta1

xenia_manager.releaseNotes:
# 🛠️ Xenia Manager v5.0.0

> This is a really big update under the hood so let us know if you find any bugs so we can fix them as soon as possible. While we have been testing this for a while on our own installs across multiple devices, bugs can still slip us.

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

- **Two Executables in the Release**
  The release artifact now ships `XeniaManager.BigScreen.exe` alongside `XeniaManager.exe`. Extract both into the same folder so the manager can find Big Screen.

---

## 📝 Changelog

### ✨ New Features

- **Game Files Explorer (replaces Open Game Location)** ([30b607e](https://github.com/xenia-manager/xenia-manager/commit/30b607e6c1762bf537562d8915d08002270b2b29), [e3c0798](https://github.com/xenia-manager/xenia-manager/commit/e3c07986afd4e51ab28cac4e705b58c5edcdc9ef), [940ef75](https://github.com/xenia-manager/xenia-manager/commit/940ef751930d4bfa73d13a60263b52ac2be3b20a), [707b562](https://github.com/xenia-manager/xenia-manager/commit/707b5629d15faa97fddcc222af1e1980faff909b), [82dea3a](https://github.com/xenia-manager/xenia-manager/commit/82dea3ab8e4d1663630a06e60a892cb9ef977891), [bdd154a](https://github.com/xenia-manager/xenia-manager/commit/bdd154a6eb1b67bc461c592edd551633a5e0380f), [3428730](https://github.com/xenia-manager/xenia-manager/commit/3428730918cfe39587c32fc39008ddf991c104e4), [fb4b946](https://github.com/xenia-manager/xenia-manager/commit/fb4b9462a7161843e56a78a80b6aea801d6f285a), [1eaafd3](https://github.com/xenia-manager/xenia-manager/commit/1eaafd3cf67ffd3b156d0a5e6254960f356883f8), [5d0ed3f](https://github.com/xenia-manager/xenia-manager/commit/5d0ed3f43fe766f743b734683db05209cbe9b8f1), [de12efd](https://github.com/xenia-manager/xenia-manager/commit/de12efd465d27d9f414b002392f067b5f18a4d69), [ba8ddbc](https://github.com/xenia-manager/xenia-manager/commit/ba8ddbc5f8d9c00cf0578d238b91af738a6c5203), [b8337ef](https://github.com/xenia-manager/xenia-manager/commit/b8337efa909d8b828d2ef0dd0a9b7b587c080d4a))
  Replaces the Open Game Location action with an in-app, read-only browser for a game's container, opened from the library context menu with multi-disc support. A preloaded directories-first tree with live search, reveal-in-tree and multiselect sits beside a details pane that shows parsed XEX metadata (title/media IDs, version, disc, image size, module flags), the SPA summary (title, achievement count, gamerscore, icon), STFS metadata with thumbnail for CON/LIVE/PIRS packages, embedded image previews (PNG/JPG/BMP) and every SPA achievement with localized name/description, icon and gamerscore badge; a bottom panel summarizes the container format, file count and total size. Double-clicking smart-opens files — text into a selectable viewer with an encoding footer, `.gpd` into a read-only GPD viewer with achievements and entry table, and unknown files probed for STFS magic into a nested dialog — while the XEX details dialog loads in two cancellable stages (fast header first, full details on demand) and shows base version, executable type (Retail/Debug), icon export to PNG and a per-language achievement selector. xenios.releaseNotes:
Faster shader compiles, and a signed, notarized Mac app.

Requires iOS / iPadOS 26 or later. A Mac build for Apple Silicon (macOS 15 or later) is attached as well.

## Changes

- Shader compilation is up to 43% faster. Measured on an iPhone across 10 game scenes, compile time dropped by 29% to 43% per scene, and by 36% overall. Shaders are now built with the game's fetch settings filled in, a shader that is only ever used that way no longer gets a second, generic copy, and the shader converter folds more constant work before handing a shader to iOS.
- Stored shaders are rebuilt once after updating, because shader translation changed.
- Mac: the app is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so macOS opens it without the unidentified developer warning.

xenra_360.releaseNotes:
## Xenra 0.5.0

### A new platform: iOS

Xenra ships on iPad and iPhone for the first time, as one app with both
consoles:

- Xbox 360 and original Xbox cores, the Metal renderer, JIT through StikDebug,
  and the floating pad with physical controller support.
- Dashboard, game library with box art and covers, setup wizard, per-game
  settings, sharing logs, crash and thermal reports.
- Xbox 360 System Link netplay over the local network, with a signed-in profile.
- Original Xbox Live through Insignia: console DNS, setup assistant and the
  retail dashboard, all from the app.

The iOS and Android screens share their wording and layout, so a guide written
for one applies to the other.

### Original Xbox: the Performance core

The Performance core is the default original Xbox core on Android, chosen per
game at launch. xemu remains for the dashboard, the Insignia setup assistant and
the games the performance core cannot run, exactly the split the game menu
already understands. The core names in the library and per-game settings are now
Performance and Compatibility, matching the 360 side.

### Mali GPUs and compatibility rendering

- Compatibility rendering for Mali, selectable per device and per game.
- The custom-driver gate accepts Mali devices, so Exynos users can use driver
  ZIPs through the same picker as Adreno.
- Mali texture, presentation and fallback fixes, including the cases that left
  a black frame or the wrong colour after a swap.

### Performance

- The 360 Performance core's frame generator was reworked: motion search,
  warp and smoothing, with the same quality checks.
- Android: the library's fuzzy cover-art match for an uncached title now runs
  on a background lane instead of the UI thread, removing the per-title stall
  the 0.4.0 notes queued for this cycle.
- On iOS, the Metal command processor spreads new shader translation over
  frames, keeps a per-title pipeline cache, and no longer runs the shader
  entry-point regex scan on the common path. A Halo 3 profile put roughly a
  third of CPU samples in that regex before this change; it now runs only if
  the entry point cannot be bound. The strlen-style trim and presence-string
  parsers in the shared core also stopped building regexes per call.

### Texture and bug fixes

- Crash Bandicoot: The Wrath of Cortex - original Xbox texture artifact fixed.
- First-shader stutter removed.
- A long list of shared 360 core fixes: sockets, TLS, XEX loading, file
  attributes, timers, memory leaks and bounds checks.
- On iOS, Exit Game no longer quits the app, app shortcuts open a game
  directly, and analog sticks no longer degrade into presses.

### Custom on-screen controls

Every button and stick can be dragged to a new place, saved, reset or cancelled
from the in-game menu. The layout is stored per device and applies to both
consoles, and the emulator pauses while the editor is open.

### Design

A minor refresh: the 360 controller UI is green, the dashboard and onboarding
screens share a design across Android and iOS, and Netplay and Xbox Live have
matching screens on both platforms.

### Install

**Android has a new package name.** It is `Mohammed.Xanite.android` now (the old
app was `Ali.Xanite.green`), so it installs alongside the old app instead of
over it, and saves do not move by themselves:

1. In the old app, open **Game Data** and use **Export saves**. Keep the zip.
2. Install the new app.
3. In the new app, open **Game Data** and use **Import saves from a zip**.
4. Pick your BIOS and game folders again, and set up profiles and controls once.

Keep the old app installed until its saves are imported. Shader caches rebuild
automatically and are not worth copying.

iOS is a new install and has nothing to migrate.

| Platform | Package | Version |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Android | `Mohammed.Xanite.android` | 0.5.0 |
| iOS | `Mohammed.Xanite.ios` | 0.5.0 |

ymir_pc.releaseNotes:
This is a nightly release built from the latest commit. Before you use these builds, **make sure to backup your data, especially the save states!**

Save states are constantly evolving and are only guaranteed to be compatible on stable (numbered) releases.
The file format may be changed without notice, so be careful when using save states from nightly releases.

You can find the changelog for this build [here](https://github.com/ymir-emu/Ymir/blob/latest-nightly/CHANGELOG.md).

> [!NOTE]
> Nightly builds include experimental and in-development features that may not work properly.
> When reporting issues, make sure to include the version number (Help > About > Copy version).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> It is recommended to install the latest GPU drivers in order to use Direct3D or Vulkan:
> - Nvidia: [Find your GPU here](https://www.nvidia.com/Download/index.aspx?lang=en-us) or [use the Nvidia App to update drivers automatically](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/software/nvidia-app/)
> - AMD: [Find your GPU or CPU here](https://www.amd.com/en/support) or use the download buttons at the top to update drivers automatically
> - Intel: [Find your GPU or CPU here](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/download-center/home.html)
>
> Windows users: install the latest [Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable package](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist) ([x86_64 installer](https://aka.ms/vc14/vc_redist.x64.exe), [AArch64/ARM64 installer](https://aka.ms/vc14/vc_redist.arm64.exe)) before running the emulator. This is **mandatory** to avoid crashes on startup.
>
> macOS users: follow [these instructions](https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/open-a-mac-app-from-an-unknown-developer-mh40616/mac) to allow Ymir to run on your system. Ymir is signed with an ad-hoc certificate, flagging it as unverified.
>
> Linux users: if you choose to install the Flatpak version, make sure to [grant Ymir permission to access the filesystem](https://github.com/ymir-emu/Ymir/blob/main/TROUBLESHOOTING.md#game-discs-dont-load-with-the-flatpak-release) or your disc images won't load properly.

zesarux_spec.devReleaseNotes:
ZEsarUX 13.1 Beta 1 - Zorro edition. 17 November 2026

* New things added:

Added machine ZX Evo Baseconf (fixed actually)
Added machines Scorpion ZS-256, Scorpion ZS-256 Turbo+, Scorpion GMX
Added machines ATM Turbo 1, ATM Turbo 2, ATM Turbo 2+, ATM Turbo 3
Added machine Didaktik Gama
Added machines Microdigital TK90X ULA Ferranti (Spanish and Portuguese)
Allow to render emulated display on a separate window
Added configuration file setting for enabling to use numeric keys on Azerty keyboard, without having to press Shift
Added more different joystick support for Mac (Dpad, different axis)
Added 60 hz support for machines: Master System, SG1000, MSX, Colecovision, Spectravideo, Timex Sinclair 2068
Added real video rendering for PCW, Jupiter Ace and Sam Coupe
Allow to send private messages to users on ZENG Online
Allow to smartload a SCL file
Added device icons: esxdos handler, kartusho, iFrom, lec memory, superupgrade
Added support for triggering F-function actions from joystick (Reset CPU, Open window, NMI, etc). Also, joystick events "Quicksave", "Rewind", "FForward" have been removed and can be triggered now as actions
Allow to select output file from the External Audio Source window
Added another toys "Clive" and "Simon" to Procrastinate menu
Allow preffix $ and 0x for hexadecimal values
Allow to debug esxdos calls on debug console
Allow to view and extract Hobeta files (.$C, etc)
Allow to use non-standard size for ide images
Allow tape traps saving from Super Tape Copier or Lao Copy 2
Allow to select Beeper & MIC audio mode on Spectrum (to save loading sound, for example)
Allow to pause CPU
Allow to find bytes from Hexadecimal Editor

* Improvements:

Improved Sinclair QL emulation:
- Added Qsound emulation
- Improved intel 8049 sound
- Allow to change QL border color
- Improved display aspect ratio. Graphics now match the original hardware geometry (1.476:1). Allow also 4:3 and 1:1
- Added Vision-QL color palette
- Added QL QIMI Mouse emulation
- Added CPU_TURBO extension to Super Basic to allow to change CPU speed
- Added flp2 drive
- Allow smartload of files type boot, basic or executables, running sentences lrun_ or exec_ automatically
- Allow to smartload .mdv images
- Added support for all kind of .mdv files
- Added support for .img (QDOS QL5A / QL5B) images
- Added support for .win images
- Allow to load additional ROMS (for example tkii220.rom)
- Allow to send keystrokes (read clipboard or read from text file) to QL
- Allow to use PC real-time clock or QL internal
- Allow to change timezone for RTC
- Save real time internal QL clock on ZSF snapshots
- Added support for text mode video drivers (stdout, simpletext)

Improved ZX Vision:
- Added Clock window
- Added Calculator window
- Improved menu organization, wording and consistency across the user interface
- Improved window movement when moving with mouse
- Handle function keys while top menu is open
- Process switcher now shows one row of processes by default
- Draw window frame on background windows
- Main menus when top menu is enabled do not have window title
- Allow to hide menus from top menu
- Allow to show Top Menu short menu names
- Add to recent files/folders list when selecting a folder (for example esxdos handler directory or ql mdv)
- Allow to click on a previous submenu

Improved ZX Desktop:
- Allow to sort icons alphabetically
- Allow to change bitmap of an icon
- Allow to close a open window by right-click on its ZX Desktop icon
- Check if item is on an invalid position when recovering it from Trash

Improved TR-DOS integration on Pentagon
Improved Virtual Keyboard: allow to scale keyboard
Add casing views to Visual Floppy (disk, clear case, opaque case)
